claim_a: Company: less than 10 percent of all Altair owners have bought BASIC
claim_b: BYTE: more copies of Altair's BASIC have been pirated than have been legally sold
why_they_differ: Both describe unpaid copying but imply different paid fractions (under 10 percent versus under 50 percent)
evidence_weight: Neither is a measurement, and BYTE is downstream of the company's own claim, so it cannot corroborate it
best_supported_interpretation: Treat the paid fraction as a company assertion with no independent denominator; the hcc0203 reader's 'one of the 10 percent minority' adopts the company's number rather than counting it
residual_uncertainty: True paid fraction and the Altair installed base are UNKNOWN and probably unrecoverable
